about: A quit after a mission ends with exit code 0, not the crash at helldivers2.exe+0x626296 (#332, docs/crash-guards.md). The harness must end the session through the game's own quit (Application.quit, as the menu's Quit does) after the mission, with a mod set that fills the job pool at quit (the full Clones preset crashed 5 of 5). The line 'the game is quitting and a full job pool' shows the new path ran; without a stall at quit it is not written and the quit is normal anyway.
